notes.title: 8/9/24 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Continued fixes on edge cases that interfere with winning or losing correctly 
[*]Sound and music fixes 
[*]Background performance tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.04r1
notes.notes: Fixes the resolution issue, should reset your window to 1080 and windowed.

notes.title: 8/7/24 Updates
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]A button to our Discord is now in the main menu. We welcome everyone to converse, discuss the game, and bring up bugs
[*]Continuing to eliminate data flow issues that cause problems for the AI and victory screen.
[*]A few sound tweaks, mainly Icicle Launcher
[*]A few visual tweaks including the text in the opening cutscene
[/list]

notes.title: 1.03 patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Discord button added to main page; takes you to our server for bug reports and feedback
[*]Fixed cases where shocking flamethrowers caused bosses to not die properly
[*]Some performance improvements across the board
[/list]

notes.title: The SECOND patch!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Visual error related to circular rangefinders fixed
[*]Specific cases preventing win screen fixed
[*]Fixed cases where leaving play/restarting caused hotkeys to fail
[/list]

notes.title: First patch!
notes.notes:
Hello all!
The first patch should fix the following:
[list]
[*]Textbox in the tutorial no longer blocks some buildable tiles during Supercharger tutorial
[*]Progress is no longer offset back by 1 mission, unlocks and progress tics should appear properly if they did not
[/list]
